prompt: Unprompted aside to R2-07 (seed-specific information / scale-charge estimate), filed at the user's request for a further off-the-wall angle.
summary: Treats phase slips in the free stream as particles and asks whether a gas of them on the ScaleCharges doubling clock defeats every constant C. The clock is forbidden outright by Golden's no-00 clause (F001, FAILED), and slips do not cooperate (F002). What the chase produced instead: a single slip at index 94 reconstructs to a row of density 3/14, giving charge ratio 7/2 and refuting C = 3 if the stream is achievable (F003), and the whole family's ratio is quantised as 42/k with k >= 12 observed (F004). Exact integer arithmetic; the L = 94 result is verified on two independent implementations.
arithmetic: exact integers and fractions.Fraction; no floating-point quantity is relied on

findings.title: A doubling slip schedule is forbidden by Golden, not merely unachieved
findings.claim: Golden's no-00 clause holds for a slip set iff the first slip is at an even index (phase 0) and every consecutive gap is odd (0 mismatches over all 65,535 slip sets in positions 0..15). A doubling schedule m*2^j has an even gap at every step after the first, so no doubling schedule of three or more slips is Golden, for any m (enumerated m = 1..40, k = 2..5). Since free R is always Golden, the off-the-wall idea of slipping once per doubling is unavailable. The 11111 clause is a separate restriction and is not a run-length law on the slip set; three candidate thresholds were tested and all three fail.

findings.title: Phase slips do not cooperate: a gas of defects is worse than one well-placed defect
findings.claim: Best exact eventual density of Theta f: 3/14 for one slip (L = 94), 9/28 for two slips ([0, 13]) and 2/7 for three ([0, 1, 26]) over legal sets with positions <= 60. At the single-slip optimum L = 26 every legal second slip lowered the finite-n ratio, 2.4896 -> 2.0078 at best. This is a measurement over tested configurations, not a proved anti-cooperation law.

findings.title: One slip at index 94 gives ratio 7/2, which would refute C = 3 for every B
findings.claim: The alternating Golden stream with a single slip at index 94 reconstructs to a row of exact period 28 with 6 black cells, density 3/14, so the charge ratio tends to 3/(4*3/14) = 7/2. 5*zeros - n - 3*blackCount is negative through the transient (-546 at n = 1000, -336 at n = 2000), crosses zero between n = 2000 and n = 4000, then grows: +93, +954, +2235 at n = 4000, 8000, 14000. Recomputed on a second independent implementation with 0 disagreements over depths 0..1600. CONDITIONAL: no finite right half realising this stream is exhibited. Over all 65,535 right halves supported in positions 1..16 only slip indices 1 and 2 arise as single-slip streams, so the distance from round two's achieved 2.3288 to 7/2 is entirely achievability.
findings.missing_lemma: For even L >= 3, decide whether the Golden stream f_L(s) = (s + [s >= L]) mod 2 lies in the image of R |-> free R over finite right halves R. Equivalently: exhibit a finite R with free R = f_94, or prove the image contains no single-slip stream with L >= 3 (which would cap the achievable single-slip ratio at 21/10).

findings.title: The sparsity ladder is quantised: ratio_inf = 42/k, with k >= 12 observed
findings.claim: Over all 230 legal single slips with L <= 1200 every eventual density of Theta f has denominator dividing 56 (observed periods 7, 14, 28, 56), so ratio_inf = 42/k where k is the black count per 56 depths. Observed k runs 12..39 plus 48; the minimum k = 12 is attained exactly once, at L = 94. A proof of k >= 12 would make 7/2 the exact supremum of the single-slip family. Nothing here bounds k below.

artifacts.description: Exact reimplementation of the official rule/drv/altCol/u/free/alt/recon/lam/Theta/Psi/zeros/blackCount, with a selftest reproducing the published kernel-checked C=1 witness. Carried over unchanged from the round-two response.
Independently written non-bit-packed implementation (dicts, literal Lean recursions) used as the second code path for F003. Carried over unchanged from the round-two response.
First pass on the slip-gas idea: single slips, two-slip interaction by gap, the geometric clock (which fails), uniform spacing, and an exhaustive slip-set search in a window.

F001: the parity law for Golden slip sets, verified over all 65,535 slip sets in positions 0..15, the refutation of three run-length readings of the 11111 clause, and the enumeration showing no doubling schedule of three or more slips is Golden for m = 1..40.
F002: exact eventual densities of Theta f by period detection, over legal single, two- and three-slip sets.
F004: the single-slip density sweep to L = 1200, with the full density ladder.
The achievability gap: every right half supported in positions 1..16, the slip schedules its free stream realises, and which low-density schedules are not reached.
F003: the L = 94 headline recomputed on both implementations and tabulated to n = 14000.
Output of A007 at W = 16, n = 70.
The report: four classified findings and the missing lemma.
